text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During break time, while strolling through 
the academy grounds, I spotted Sakura 
Chiyono O hiding in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Over there, isn't that Spe-san and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: M-Maruzen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the weather's gorgeous, so how about 
going for a drive? It feels super 
refreshing~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A drive, you say?! Umm... S-Safe driving, 
please, I'd love to!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
............ A drive with Maruzen-san... 
That sounds so nice, desu ne.
choice_data_list: Why don't you ask for a ride too?
Why don't you ask for a ride too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah... T-Trainer! No, ...it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Well, the truth is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Sakura Chiyono O looking so 
crestfallen caught my concern, so I 
decided to ask her for the full story.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Actually, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I get terribly motion sick!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Chiyo-chan♪ If you'd like, want to go 
for a drive down to the beach with me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
! A-Are you sure you want me to come 
along? I'd love to...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(It'll be fine... right? Surely, just this 
much will be—)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's step on the gas!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VROOOOOOOOOOMMMMM!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I got motion sick. Completely, utterly 
motion sick.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As for what happened after that... please 
use your imagination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, she seems to be 
considerate of me, so she doesn't invite 
me out on drives anymore...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to cause trouble for her 
either, so even when seeing other girls 
being invited, I tell myself it can't be 
helped...
choice_data_list: Are you just going to keep holding it in?
Are you just going to keep holding it in?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-That's... but, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh. To be honest... I want to... I 
want to as well...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to go for a drive together with 
Maruzen-san, whom I admire so much~!!
choice_data_list:
How about training yourself not to get 
motion sick?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*. I did try to get used to 
riding in vehicles before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But whenever I remember that time, my 
courage just completely shrinks away...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides... seeing how pathetic I am makes 
me feel like I'm drifting further and 
further away from Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. It's no good to dwell on 
thoughts like this, is it?
choice_data_list:
Let's research before jumping straight 
into practice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Research... You mean like what causes 
motion sickness?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...That makes a lot of sense. Even when 
trying to acclimate, there must be a 
proper way to do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Rather than sulking and envying others, 
that sounds way better, desu!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's truly a matter of 'Know the earth 
before the flower blooms!'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ! I'm going to give it a try, ganbaru!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Improving one's physical constitution is 
no easy feat, but Sakura Chiyono O took 
her first step forward to find a solution.
